summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'), so order creation, the worker and the ledger sync all fail on writes. The cause of the read-only state is unknown, and no available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should find out why the DB is read-only. Check the file or volume permissions, a full disk, a filesystem remounted read-only, or a DB lock or mode change, then restore write access.
After writes work again, run check_invariants. Then check_data_integrity, and reprocess_orders or repair_ledger if anything is flagged.
Check that the queued order (275.29 SAR) is processed once the DB is writable.
Restarting the worker or rolling back would not help: the errors began long after the v1.3 deploy, and the worker can't write to the DB.
